subject: geography
title: Glacial Landforms
welcome_lead: Glaciers carve amazing landscapes. Discover corries, arêtes, U-shaped valleys and more!
meta_desc: KS3 Geography adventure on glacial landforms including corries and U-shaped valleys.
final_note: Excellent! You can now spot glacial features in a landscape.

walkthroughs.body_html: Snow piles in a hollow, becomes ice, deepens the hollow into a corrie. Two corries back-to-back form an arête. Three+ form a pyramidal peak (like the Matterhorn).
Rivers carve V-shaped valleys; glaciers widen them into U-shapes with steep sides and flat bottoms. After ice melts, these stay.
Corries fill with water to form tarns. Smaller side valleys are left hanging high above the main valley, often with waterfalls.
